case.rationale: Measure bicycle right-edge position and standing-vehicle passing clearance; preserve qualitative exceptions and due care for review.

route_and_standing_vehicle.value: same authored right-edge road, standing vehicle, weather and absent nearby traffic/turn

probe.comparison_or_standard: measured body-to-edge and passing-clearance contrast, not legal threshold

unresolved_judgment_calls: as near to the right side of the roadway as practicable
exercising due care when passing a standing vehicle
When doing so would not be safe
